example.command: python -m nexo web build examples/web/static/app.nexo --static -o dist
example.purpose: Noninteractive scalar component HTML with scoped CSS and no JavaScript
example.scope: Experimental M6a. Shared frontend compilation is checked here; associated tests verify static HTML output and browser execution with JavaScript disabled.
example.source:
use nexo.web

pub component Welcome:
    state version: int = 6
    view:
        main:
            Heading(label: "Nexo Web static HTML"):
                p("An experimental M{version} page, readable without JavaScript.")
    style:
        main { max-width: 48rem; margin: 3rem auto; padding: 1rem; }

component Heading(label: str):
    view:
        h1(label)
        slot()

verification.browser_execution: Run associated tests; not asserted by this generator
